main_measure.name: slope of 7-bar excess forward return on forecast (grid cases, day-clustered)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check > 0; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move in signal's direction > 0

decided_by: The slope is positive with t >= 2 and the mean unusual move in the signal's direction is above 0.
reading: The 30-bar efficiency ratio is recomputed from each window's closes and, on a window's first 30 bars where it cannot be, the recorded regime stands in; the side is the sign of the recorded raw scaled move (7-bar return where missing); the slope's t uses day-clustered standard errors, and the supporting check uses the same grid cases with excess return signed by the forecast.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.0002274 on the check folds against +0.0009705 on every fold
